derivation: amendment A12: 'mailto:x@alpha.example' has a scheme but no authority, so it is not an absolute URL with scheme and authority; A4 keeps it a single `hreflang_relative_href`.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="mailto:x@alpha.example">
</head><body></body></html>
